openssl_3_6.reason: Opt-in compatibility floor for the August and September 2026 fixes. Default reviewed package snapshots already select OpenSSL 3.6.5 or 3.5.9; this overlay is not required by them. Source URL and hash match the reviewed stable Nixpkgs recipe. See docs/dependencies.md.
openssl_3_6.removeWhen: All supported default Nixpkgs snapshots supply the applicable fixes without this override; verify base and unstable package sets on Linux and Darwin, then remove the override and its record.
validation: Native package/host checks qualify source integration; deployment and process restarts are separate.
